# Roland Tech

> Roland Tech is an e-commerce agency that designs and builds online stores on Shopify, Wix and Webflow, then helps them grow with Facebook Ads, SEO, graphic design and product research. Founded by Roland. Works with clients worldwide, remotely.

## Services
- Shopify store design and development: custom themes and sections, apps and payments, mobile-first stores.
- Wix and Wix Studio websites: online stores and booking sites owners can edit themselves.
- Webflow websites: custom interactions and client-editable CMS.
- Facebook Ads management: Meta Pixel and Conversions API setup, creative testing, budget scaling.
- E-commerce SEO: technical audits, schema markup, collection page optimisation.
- Product research: demand checks, competitor margins, launch plans.

## Team
- Roland: Founder and Ecommerce Director, main point of contact.
- Anu: Marketing Director.
- Dave: Website Director.
- Ife: Graphics Director.

## Facts
- 40+ happy clients and 60+ projects delivered.
- Replies to enquiries within 24 hours. First call is free; every project gets a clear quote before work starts.
- Typical Shopify or Wix build: 2 to 4 weeks.
